response.sql: WITH source_metrics AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference, SUM(s.aream2) / NULLIF(SUM(s.volm3), 0) AS area_to_volume FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), cross_source AS (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume) AS avg_ratio FROM source_metrics) SELECT m.fundflux, m.avg_y_vs_x_difference, m.area_to_volume, m.area_to_volume - c.avg_ratio AS above_average_by FROM source_metrics AS m CROSS JOIN cross_source AS c WHERE m.area_to_volume > c.avg_ratio;

assumptions.assumption: Missing funding sources are excluded. Area and volume totals each ignore their own NULL values; zero denominators yield NULL and are excluded from the cross-source average.

alternatives.interpretation: Count a spatial record in the area and volume totals only when both values are present.
alternatives.sql: WITH source_metrics AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference, SUM(CASE WHEN s.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 IS NOT NULL THEN s.aream2 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 IS NOT NULL THEN s.volm3 END), 0) AS area_to_volume FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), cross_source AS (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume) AS avg_ratio FROM source_metrics) SELECT m.fundflux, m.avg_y_vs_x_difference, m.area_to_volume, m.area_to_volume - c.avg_ratio AS above_average_by FROM source_metrics AS m CROSS JOIN cross_source AS c WHERE m.area_to_volume > c.avg_ratio;
